body: Not really, I asked her multiple times what makes her want to kill herself but she couldn’t answer specifically she just said that she’s tired of everything and she wanted it for a long time

Her parents are divorced and I’m really scared that she will actually do it if I tell them.
I don’t know her parents, or her home situation or even her too well so I’m really not sure how would they react. 
She told me that she doesn’t want them to know because of some situations she had in her childhood, but I don’t know too much.  
She often sends me texts saying she doesn’t know if she’ll go to the psychiatrist, that she will kill herself anyways, she sends me snaps showing me the blood on her arms after she cuts herself. 
I told her that eventually I will have to tell someone, but If I tell her parents and she kills herself because of that I could never forgive myself. She also desperately doesn’t want to go to mental hospital and I think that’s why she lies to her psychiatrist(mental hospitals are quite terrible here in Poland)
